# OpenCode Gemini Rotator V2

> Native OpenCode V2 server plugin for automatic Google Gemini API key rotation on 429 Rate Limits, 503 errors, and quota exhaustion.

OpenCode Gemini Rotator V2 (`opencode-v2-gemini-rotator`) handles HTTP 429 (Rate Limit / Resource Exhausted), HTTP 503 (Service Overloaded), quota limits, and invalid keys during AI coding sessions in OpenCode 2.2.0+. It provides seamless multi-key fallback across a pool of up to 256 Google Gemini API keys without monkey-patching fetch or adding external proxy processes.
